text_block_list.text:
As part of the academy's volunteer 
activities, we were set to pick up trash 
with the students. The team I was assigned 
to supervise was...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We're he~re! This area is our assigned 
sector~. Alright everyone, let's give it 
our all♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ye~es. Ugh, it's so warm... Why did it 
have to be such nice weather on a day like 
this~?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
My back huuurts, this is exhausting. Ah, 
hey, what kind of trash is this~?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Shh, it's written on the handout, right~? 
If we're too loud, she'll—ah............

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...? What?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's nothing at all! We're taking it 
totally seriously! Going back to wooork!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Taishin-cha~n? Is something wrong~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing. I'm going to take care of the 
underpass.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh, by yourself? Ah...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Hmm~? What's up with her...?)

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-senpai... I wonder if she's mad 
after all...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Mad? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Nothing really, but... 
Taishin-senpai was working so quietly and 
seriously. We were slacking off, so, um...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? Taishin-chan doesn't seem like the 
type to care about that sort of thing...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, my? Did something happen with 
Taishin-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Creek-sa~n. Well, you see~... 
Taishin-chan went off over there all by 
herself...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why don't we all head over together? 
That way, we can casu~ally ask her what's 
up...

And so, everyone headed over to Narita 
Taishin. When Hishi Miracle found the 
right moment to bring up what happened 
earlier...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Serious? Me? As if...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...? Then... were we just 
misunderstanding?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to get it over with quickly 
so I could go train. I'm not mad or 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
See~? Finding it a drag is something we 
all have in common~.

As an academy Trainer, I shouldn't nod 
along. ...However, I completely understood 
both what Hishi Miracle was saying and how 
everyone felt.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, my, what troublesome children. Even 
so, since you're all do~ing your part 
properly, eve~ryone's being such a good 
child♪
choice_data_list:
That's right, let's keep it up until the 
end!

That's right, let's keep it up until the 
end!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Oka~y! Well, picking up trash is a good 
thing after all. It's a pain, but let's do 
our best until the end~~!!

By openly sharing their unpretentious, 
honest feelings, a strange sense of 
solidarity had formed. And then, the trash 
cleanup wrapped up without any problems—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Miracle-chan today, the 
atmosphere became so nice and wa~rm. ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Me? Did I even do anything...?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You certainly did, our little mood maker♪ 
Miracle-chan, you really are an amazing 
girl. I can see it clearly~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mood maker...? N-No way, that's just— Ah, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it... The other day, No 
Reason-chan was showering me with praise, 
saying I was 'amazing' too)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Could it be that I actually have 
something going for me? Like an identity, 
or an incredible talent~...?!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe... Did I really do something that 
amazing~? Maybe I did...?
choice_data_list: You really saved the day today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, isn't that right? Miracle-chan is 
such a good girl~♪ There, the~re♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, I am a Tracen Academy student after 
all~. Just kidding... hehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well. At least I avoided an annoying 
misunderstanding...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Even Taishin-chan...?! Eeeh...?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I might... actually be kind of amazing 
after all...?!
